title: Intake for verifying one claim about your model
description: The minimal set a client provides, per the YOU PROVIDE card of the one-pager: one claim, code and settings, data or a run on the client's side.

claim.description: One claim about the model to verify, in a single sentence.

code_and_settings.description: Code and settings: the saved code version, computation settings, initial values, library versions.

data_or_run.description: Data (a depersonalized fragment) or a run on the client's side.
